72346-social-life-in-old-new-orleans.title: _Being Recollections of my Girlhood_
72346-social-life-in-old-new-orleans.creator: Eliza Ripley
72346-social-life-in-old-new-orleans.description: A book by Eliza Ripley. “Children should be seen and not heard.” Children were neither seen nor heard in the days of which I write, the days of 1840. They led the simple life, going and coming in their own unobtrusive way, making no stir in fashionable circles, with laces and flounces and feathered hats. There were no ready-made garments then for grown-ups, much less for children.

arxiv-1412-4027.title: A note on period domains of Hodge structures
arxiv-1412-4027.creator: Mohammad Reza Rahmati
arxiv-1412-4027.description: A 2014 arXiv research paper by Mohammad Reza Rahmati. We present period domains of complex Hodge structures and some of their basic properties from representation theory point of view. Specifically we introduce the automorphic cohomology of period domains and the complex structure on symmetric spaces.

arxiv-2106-02518.title: Cohomological DT invariants from localization
arxiv-2106-02518.creator: Pierre Descombes
arxiv-2106-02518.description: Abstract Given a quiver with potential associated to a toric Calabi-Yau threefold, the numerical Donaldson-Thomas invariants for the moduli space of framed representations can be computed by using toric localization, which reduces the problem to the enumeration of pyramid partitions. We provide a refinement of this localization procedure, which allows to compute cohomological Donaldson-Thomas invariants.

arxiv-2110-00434.title: Towards Protecting Face Embeddings in Mobile Face Verification Scenarios
arxiv-2110-00434.creator: Vedrana Krivokuća Hahn and Sébastien Marcel
arxiv-2110-00434.description: Abstract This paper proposes PolyProtect, a method for protecting the sensitive face embeddings that are used to represent people’s faces in neural-network-based face verification systems. PolyProtect transforms a face embedding to a more secure template, using a mapping based on multivariate polynomials parameterised by user-specific coefficients and exponents.

arxiv-2110-02986.title: RG and Stability in the Exciton Bose Liquid
arxiv-2110-02986.creator: Ethan Lake
arxiv-2110-02986.description: Abstract The exciton Bose liquid (EBL) is a hypothesized phase of bosons in 2+1D which possesses a dispersion that is gapless along the coordinate axes in momentum space. The low energy theory of the EBL involves modes on all length scales, extending all the way down to the lattice spacing.

arxiv-2206-09901.title: Only Tails Matter: Average-Case Universality and Robustness in the Convex Regime
arxiv-2206-09901.creator: Leonardo Cunha, Gauthier Gidel, Fabian Pedregosa, Damien Scieur, Courtney Paquette
arxiv-2206-09901.description: Abstract The recently developed average-case analysis of optimization methods allows a more fine-grained and representative convergence analysis than usual worst-case results. In exchange, this analysis requires a more precise hypothesis over the data generating process, namely assuming knowledge of the expected spectral distribution (ESD) of the random matrix associated with the problem.

arxiv-2208-10215.title: On the monophonic convexity in complementary prisms
arxiv-2208-10215.creator: Neethu P. K, Ullas Chandran S. V, Julliano R. Nascimento
arxiv-2208-10215.description: Abstract A set S S of vertices of a graph G G is monophonic convex if S S contains all the vertices belonging to any induced path connecting two vertices of S S . The cardinality of a maximum proper monophonic convex set of G G is called the monophonic convexity number of G G .

arxiv-2311-04042.title: Analyzing Near-Infrared Hyperspectral Imaging for Protein Content Regression and Grain Variety Classification Using Bulk References and Varying Grain-to-Background Ratios
arxiv-2311-04042.creator: Ole-Christian Galbo Engstrøm, Erik Schou Dreier, Birthe Møller Jespersen, Kim Steenstrup Pedersen
arxiv-2311-04042.description: Abstract Based on previous work, we assess the use of NIR-HSI images for calibrating models on two datasets, focusing on protein content regression and grain variety classification. Limited reference data for protein content is expanded by subsampling and associating it with the bulk sample.

arxiv-2403-01223.title: The generalised Mooney space for modelling the response of rubber-like materials †
arxiv-2403-01223.creator: Afshin Anssari-Benam, Andrea Bucchi, Michel Destrade, Giuseppe Saccomandi
arxiv-2403-01223.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Afshin Anssari-Benam, Andrea Bucchi, Michel Destrade, Giuseppe Saccomandi. Soft materials such as rubbers, silicones, gels and biological tissues have a nonlinear response to large deformations, a phenomenon which in principle can be captured by hyperelastic models. The suitability of a candidate hyperelastic strain energy function is then determined by comparing its predicted response to the data gleaned from tests and adjusting the material parameters to get a good fit, an exercise which can be deceptive because of nonlinearity.

arxiv-2405-19897.title: The Political Resource Curse Redux
arxiv-2405-19897.creator: Hanyuan Jiang
arxiv-2405-19897.description: Abstract In the study of the Political Resource Curse (Brollo et al.,2013), the authors identified a new channel to investigate whether the windfalls of resources are unambiguously beneficial to society, both with theory and empirical evidence. This paper revisits the framework with a new dataset. Specifically, we implemented a regression discontinuity design and difference-in-difference specification.

arxiv-2407-00260.title: Adiabatons in double tripod coherent atom-light coupling scheme
arxiv-2407-00260.creator: Viačeslav Kudriašov, Hamid R. Hamedi, Julius Ruseckas
arxiv-2407-00260.description: Abstract Optical adiabatons are specific shape-invariant pulse pairs propagating at the reduced group velocity and without optical absorption in the medium. The purpose of this study is to analyze and demonstrate adiabaton formation in many level atomic systems. Here we focus on the analysis of five level M-type and double tripod systems.

arxiv-2408-15430.title: High-granularity Dual-readout Calorimeter: Evolution of a Classic Prototype
arxiv-2408-15430.creator: \firstname Nural \lastname Akchurin \fnsep, \firstname James \lastname Cash, \firstname Jordan \lastname Damgov, \firstname Xander \lastname Delashaw, \firstname Kamal \lastname Lamichhane, \firstname Miles \lastname Harris, \firstname Mitch \lastname Kelley, \firstname Shuichi \lastname Kunori, \fi
arxiv-2408-15430.description: Abstract The original dual-readout calorimeter prototype (DREAM), constructed two decades ago, has proven instrumental in advancing our understanding of calorimetry. It has facilitated a multitude of breakthroughs by leveraging signals from complementary media (Cherenkov and scintillation) to capture fluctuations in electromagnetic energy fraction within hadronic showers.

arxiv-2411-12536.title: Classical and quantum chaos of closed strings on a charged confining holographic background
arxiv-2411-12536.creator: Bhaskar Shukla, Owais Riyaz, Subhash Mahapatra
arxiv-2411-12536.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Bhaskar Shukla, Owais Riyaz, Subhash Mahapatra. We discuss the classical and quantum chaos of closed strings on a recently constructed charged confining holographic background. The confining background corresponds to the charged soliton, which is a solution of minimal d = 5 d=5 gauged supergravity. The solution has a compact spacelike direction with a Wilson line on a circle and asymptotes to A ​ d ​ S 5 AdS_{5} with a planar boundary.

arxiv-2505-13814.title: Articulatory Feature Prediction from Surface EMG during Speech Production
arxiv-2505-13814.creator: Jihwan, Kevin, Kleanthis, Simon, Monica, Yoonjeong, Björn, Louis, Shrikanth
arxiv-2505-13814.description: Abstract We present a model for predicting articulatory features from surface electromyography (EMG) signals during speech production. The proposed model integrates convolutional layers and a Transformer block, followed by separate predictors for articulatory features. Our approach achieves a high prediction correlation of approximately 0.9 for most articulatory features.

arxiv-2507-20120.title: Local2Global query Alignment for Video Instance Segmentation
arxiv-2507-20120.creator: Rajat Koner, Zhipeng Wang, Srinivas Parthasarathy, Chinghang Chen
arxiv-2507-20120.description: Abstract Online video segmentation methods excel at handling long sequences and capturing gradual changes, making them ideal for real-world applications. However, achieving temporally consistent predictions remains a challenge, especially with gradual accumulation of noise or drift in online propagation, abrupt occlusions and scene transitions.

britannica-1911-commercial-treaties.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-commercial-treaties.description: Article 'Commercial Treaties' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 6), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. between states relative to trade. plos-pone-0009893.description: PLOS ONE research article. Pituitary corticotroph tumors secrete excess adrenocorticotrophic hormone (ACTH) resulting in Cushing's disease (CD). Standard treatment includes surgery and, if not successful, radiotherapy, both of which have undesirable side effects and frequent recurrence of the tumor. Pharma

pmc-10739518.title: DEVELOPMENT AND VALIDATION OF THE COUPLE EFFICACY TO BALANCE WORK AND ELDERCARE SCALE
pmc-10739518.creator: Eunae Cho, Tammy Allen, Grand Cheng
pmc-10739518.description: This study developed and validated a measure of couple efficacy to balance work and eldercare (i.e., a couple’s shared belief in their conjoint abilities to achieve work-eldercare balance as a couple), a key cognitive factor for work-eldercare arrangements, individual well-being, and work and couple outcomes.

pmc-11401399.title: Spatially fractionated GRID radiation potentiates immune-mediated tumor control
pmc-11401399.creator: Rebecca A. Bekker, Nina Obertopp, Gage Redler, José Penagaricano, Jimmy J. Caudell, Kosj Yamoah, Shari Pilon-Thomas, Eduardo G. Moros, Heiko Enderling
pmc-11401399.description: BackgroundTumor-immune interactions shape a developing tumor and its tumor immune microenvironment (TIME) resulting in either well-infiltrated, immunologically inflamed tumor beds, or immune deserts with low levels of infiltration. The pre-treatment immune make-up of the TIME is associated with treatment outcome; immunologically inflamed tumors generally exhibit better responses to radio- and immunotherapy than non-inflamed tumors.

pmc-11504243.title: Effect of Different Salinities on the Biochemical Properties and Meat Quality of Adult Freshwater Drum (Aplodinotus grunniens) During Temporary Rearing
pmc-11504243.creator: Wanwen Chen, Sharifa Mohamed Miraji, Yu Tian, Xueyan Ma, Wu Jin, Haibo Wen, Gangchun Xu, Pao Xu, Hao Cheng
pmc-11504243.description: Salinity is a significant environmental component that affects the physiological state of aquatic species. This study aimed to investigate whether water salinity had an impact on the biochemical properties and meat quality of adult Aplodinotus grunniens during temporary rearing of 7 days.

pmc-13182265.title: Functional dynamics of water in New Delhi metallo‐β‐lactamase catalysis
pmc-13182265.creator: Palanisamy Kandhan, Chuanye Xiong, Timothy Palzkill, Peng Tao
pmc-13182265.description: Water plays a critical role in the hydrolysis of antibiotics by New Delhi metallo‐β‐lactamases (NDMs). The reaction proceeds through a nucleophilic attack on the β‐lactam ring, followed by cleavage of the C–N bond and formation of an anionic nitrogen intermediate. This intermediate is then protonated by a water molecule diffusing from the bulk solvent.

pmc-13187190.title: Lifetime stressor exposure, executive functioning, and internalizing symptoms during emerging adulthood
pmc-13187190.creator: Liam Wright, Gloria Rebello, Dillon T Browne, George M Slavich, Mark Wade
pmc-13187190.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Internalizing symptoms such as depression and anxiety rise dramatically during emerging adulthood. Although both childhood and adulthood adversity are associated with internalizing symptoms during this period, the underlying transdiagnostic processes connecting adversity to internalizing symptoms are unclear. To investigate this, we examined how childhood and adulthood adversity are related to internalizing symptoms during emerging adulthood via individual differences in executive functioning.

pmc-13402402.title: Maternal and perinatal factors associated with childbirth-related post-traumatic stress symptoms: a cross-sectional study
pmc-13402402.creator: Lucyna Wójcicka, Anna Weronika Szablewska, Arkadiusz Prajzner, Agata Zdun-Ryżewska, Agnieszka Czerwińska-Osipiak, Dagmara Klasa-Mazurkiewicz
pmc-13402402.description: ObjectiveThe aim of this study was to examine how a set of selected interacting maternal and perinatal clinical characteristics are associated with symptoms of post-traumatic stress after birth.MethodsWe conducted a cross-sectional online survey among women between 3 and 18 months after birth.

pmc-13609852.title: Laser Ultrasonic Detection and Signal Enhancement of Internal Microdefects in LPBF Ti6Al4V with Anisotropic Microstructure: Simulations and Experiments
pmc-13609852.creator: Xingyu Zhou, Jia Xie, Yixuan He, Ping Hu
pmc-13609852.description: Laser Powder Bed Fusion (LPBF) has revolutionized high-end manufacturing, particularly in aerospace and biomedical fields. However, internal defects such as pores, cracks, and inclusions compromise the structural integrity and service reliability of LPBF components. Laser ultrasonics, a non-contact, broadband non-destructive testing (NDT) method, offers a promising solution for detecting and characterizing these defects.
